system.description:
Ebon Plate Mail +3 & Helm (Fighter or Paladin only). Grants four unique powers:

  • Missile Immunity: Complete immunity to non-magical missiles.
  • Flight: Dorsal wings allow limited flight up to 30' per move.
  • Extra Arms: Second pair of arms below the main arms allows wielding four 1-handed weapons, two 2-handed weapons, or two ranged weapons (does not stack with high-level Fighter/Paladin multiple attacks).
  • Giant Beetle Form (1/day, 2 turns): Transforms into a 7' giant flying beetle retaining the wearer's HP (MV 50', Bore 20', Fly 30', AC 3 [AAC 16], #AT 3 [bite 4d4, 2 horns 1d10/1d10]).
